historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Zoning Administrator and sustained the denial of the Rear Yard Variance sought for the property at 14 Sparta Street, the 3-2 vote to overrule and grant the variance falling short of the four votes needed.

The Board of Permit Appeals, on rehearing, overruled the Zoning Administrator and granted the Rear Yard Variance for the property at 14 Sparta Street, on the conditions that the addition be no more than 16 feet deep, a 20-foot yard be retained, and the wall protruding into the back yard be painted a light color.
